component.name: PCL-CE-Linux
PCL-CE-Linux
component.summary: Minecraft 启动器的 Linux 原生版本

description.p: PCL-CE-Linux is the native Linux port of the PCL-CE Minecraft launcher, built with Avalonia and a portable launcher core. It manages vanilla, snapshot and modded Minecraft installations, downloads and verifies game files, handles Fabric/Forge/NeoForge/Quilt, Microsoft/Yggdrasil/offline accounts, mods, modpacks and resource packs, and supports EasyTier based LAN multiplayer.
The application is self-contained (.NET runtime bundled), needs no Mono or Wine, ships Noto Sans CJK fonts and its icon theme, and follows the XDG Base Directory specification for all user data.

ul.li: Install and launch vanilla, snapshot and modded Minecraft versions.
Microsoft device-code login, third-party Yggdrasil and offline accounts.
Native EasyTier multiplayer rooms and LAN port forwarding.

description.p: PCL-CE-Linux 是 PCL-CE Minecraft 启动器的 Linux 原生版本，使用 Avalonia 与 可移植启动核心。支持原版、快照与模组版本安装，客户端下载与文件校验， Fabric/Forge/NeoForge/Quilt 加载器，微软 / 第三方 / 离线账号，模组、整合包与 资源包管理，以及基于 EasyTier 的原生联机。
程序自带 .NET 运行时、Noto Sans CJK 中文字体与图标主题，无需安装 Mono 或 Wine， 所有用户数据遵循 XDG Base Directory 规范。
First stable PCL-CE-Linux release, distributed as a single self-contained AppImage.
PCL-CE-Linux 首个稳定版本，以单一自包含 AppImage 形式发布。
